brief:
Amnesty International Germany has awarded its 2026 Human Rights Award to Palestinian children's rights lawyer Khaled Quzmar, recognizing his sustained advocacy defending the rights of children in occupied Palestinian territories. The award was announced in Berlin on October 13.

Quzmar receives the honor for his longstanding commitment to child protection work in the context of the Israeli occupation, according to Amnesty International.
